description: Lists Anubis offers under Settings → Lists → More lists. Add yours with a pull request.

lists.name: Official docs
lists.description: Tags first-party documentation and nudges it up.

lists.name: Discussions
lists.description: Tags forums, Q&A sites and issue threads.

lists.name: Reference
lists.description: Tags encyclopedias, archives and research papers.

lists.name: Paywalls
lists.description: Labels sites that usually paywall their articles.

lists.name: FOSS tools
lists.description: Tags selected FOSS tools and provides FOSS and AI slop labels for your sites.

lists.name: AI content (HUGE AI Blocklist)
lists.description: Labels sites made of AI-generated content, or mixing it with authentic work, using the HUGE AI Blocklist by laylavish.

lists.name: Independent wikis (Indie Wiki Buddy)
lists.description: Raises independent wikis and lowers the Fandom, Fextralife, and Neoseeker wikis they replace, using Indie Wiki Buddy's data.

lists.name: Official docs (DevDocs)
lists.description: Tags the documentation sites DevDocs collects, and nudges them up. It adds about 180 sites to Official docs.

lists.name: Huge AI Blocklist
lists.description: Hides AI-generated image and content farms. Community-maintained by laylavish. To label these sites instead, use AI content (HUGE AI Blocklist).

lists.name: AI content farms
lists.description: Hides AI-generated content farms that alvi-se adds by hand while browsing. Many are Italian sites.

lists.name: AI news and answers
lists.description: Hides sites of AI-generated news and answers. It leaves discussion of AI alone, as well as AI work that's labelled as such. Maintained by agsimmons.

lists.name: Bad Website Blocklist
lists.description: Hides AI-generated articles, low-effort spam, and advertising posing as information. Each site has an issue explaining why it was added. Maintained by popcar2.

lists.name: Stack Overflow copies
lists.description: Hides sites that scrape and machine-translate Stack Overflow.

lists.name: GitHub copies
lists.description: Hides sites that mirror GitHub repositories and issues.

lists.name: Developer site copies
lists.description: Hides sites that copy Stack Overflow, GitHub, npm, or Wikipedia, plus some SEO spam. Its Stack Overflow part is several times longer than Stack Overflow copies. Maintained by quenhus.

lists.name: Copycats removal
lists.description: Brave's Goggle that discards copycat content like translated Stack Overflow threads.

lists.name: No Pinterest
lists.description: Brave's Goggle that discards Pinterest pages.

lists.name: Tech blogs (lens)
lists.description: Brave's Goggle boosting ~1,400 tech blogs. It is a lens: results not on the list are hidden.

lists.name: Hacker News (lens)
lists.description: Brave's Goggle boosting sites popular on Hacker News. It is a lens: results not on the list are hidden.
